text: You are going to investigate the temperature changes when two different solids, N and O, dissolve
in water.
Read all the instructions carefully before starting the experiments.
Instructions
You are going to do two experiments.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Do a flame test on a small sample of solid P.
Record your observations.

Add the rest of solid P to about 10cm of distilled water in a boiling tube. Stopper the boiling
tube and shake the mixture to dissolve solid P and form solution P. Divide solution P into three
approximately equal portions in two test-tubes and one boiling tube.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
Add a few drops of aqueous sodium hydroxide to the first portion of solution P in a test-tube.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Now add an excess of aqueous sodium hydroxide to the mixture.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
Add a few drops of aqueous ammonia to the second portion of solution P in a test-tube.
Record your observations.
